ukraine_escalation_russian_capitulation.public_title: Will Russia capitulate under Western escalation pressure?
ukraine_escalation_russian_capitulation.public_summary: Macgregor argued that President Putin would settle the war on terms imposed by Russian military power on the battlefield — not through capitulation to Western pressure.
ukraine_escalation_russian_capitulation.why_it_matters: Tests whether Macgregor read Ukraine termination as Russian battlefield victory rather than negotiated yield.

ukraine_western_aid_prolongs_war.public_title: Does Western aid prolong the Ukraine war without producing victory?
ukraine_western_aid_prolongs_war.public_summary: Macgregor urged ending all aid to Kiev and withdrawing U.S. personnel — arguing Washington should host a peace conference rather than prolong the proxy war.
ukraine_western_aid_prolongs_war.why_it_matters: Tests Macgregor's aid-prolongs-war thesis against battlefield and diplomatic outcomes.

nato_strategic_exposure_ukraine.public_title: Will NATO survive the Ukraine war?
nato_strategic_exposure_ukraine.public_summary: Macgregor said NATO would not survive the war — alliance hubris and miscalculation would outlast battlefield stalemate.
nato_strategic_exposure_ukraine.why_it_matters: Tests whether Macgregor read Ukraine as an existential strain on NATO credibility, not only on Kiev.

iran_airpower_cannot_force_submission.public_title: Can air and naval power force Iran to submit?
iran_airpower_cannot_force_submission.public_summary: Macgregor argued Iran is a natural fortress — bombing cannot produce subjugation to Israeli demands; air power was the wrong instrument.
iran_airpower_cannot_force_submission.why_it_matters: Tests Macgregor's structural skepticism of coercive air campaigns against Iran.

us_israel_iran_war_preparation_2025.public_title: Is the U.S. being drawn into a regional war it cannot win?
us_israel_iran_war_preparation_2025.public_summary: Macgregor warned that either Washington disengages or risks a regional war — with insurers and Gulf economics making escalation catastrophic.
us_israel_iran_war_preparation_2025.why_it_matters: Maps Macgregor's Iran-war lane to shared registry event on active war preparation and U.S. entry risk.

israel_sabotages_exit_ramps.public_title: Will Israel sabotage diplomatic exit ramps?
israel_sabotages_exit_ramps.public_summary: Macgregor argued Netanyahu's circle blocks Trump's exit — attacks timed against agreements and leverage over U.S. policy prevent clean disengagement.
israel_sabotages_exit_ramps.why_it_matters: Tests Macgregor's claim that Israel undermines off-ramps rather than allowing U.S.-brokered exits.

gulf_crisis_macro_shock.public_title: Will Gulf escalation produce a global macroeconomic shock?
gulf_crisis_macro_shock.public_summary: Macgregor cited LNG, fertilizer, and helium supply-chain shocks — and Trump's own warning of global depression if the Strait stays closed.
gulf_crisis_macro_shock.why_it_matters: Tests Macgregor's macro-shock read of Gulf kinetic escalation beyond the battlefield.

us_forward_presence_obsolete.public_title: Is U.S. forward military presence obsolete?
us_forward_presence_obsolete.public_summary: Macgregor argued missiles and drones make forward bases indefensible — the only solution is disengagement and bringing forces home.
us_forward_presence_obsolete.why_it_matters: Tests Macgregor's structural claim that presence models fail against modern strike networks.
